row.notes: (this, car, names[8], float *outVolume) -> count. Part list [[car+8]+0x58]+0x5e0 (+0x58..+0x60, stride 0x60); for each of the 8 names (param_3[0..7], not 2) finds the part with matching name +0x10 (0x14535d850), sums AABB volumes (max-min product of +0x10/+0x20) of its sub-boxes (+0x10..+0x18, stride 0x40) into *outVolume and adds their count. Caller Sess_ScDebrisAccumulator_Update.
